name: Cosmic Clarity
body:
You can grant someone a temporary boon that stems from the whispered mutterings of the world around you.

Prerequisite(s): Any neutral alignment and Cosmic Soul Expert.

Benefit(s): You have unlocked the cosmic clarity ability.

Cosmic Clarity (Su)

Once per day, as a standard action, you may touch a target creature to grant them one of 24 the following benefits of their choice for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your HD: a combat feat or a number of skill ranks into one skill equal to their ability score modifier for that chosen skill.

The target creature must meet any prerequisites for the combat feat gained in this way and they cannot exceed the normal maximum number of skill ranks allowed for any skill based on their HD. If a combat feat granted by cosmic clarity has a daily use limitation (such as Stunning Fist), any use of that combat feat by the target creature counts towards its daily limit for that creature.

A creature can only be under the effects of one use of cosmic clarity at any given time.

Special: You may expend 2 ki points or 2 daily uses of your 1st-level power from an arcane school, elemental school, or domain to regain your daily use of cosmic clarity. You may only regain your daily use of cosmic clarity in this way once for every 4 HD you possess.
